formula: position_hat = intercept + coef_domain_prior * domain_prior + coef_url_overlap * url_overlap + coef_content_missing * content_missing - bm25f_z_weight * bm25f_z - tranco_z_weight * tranco_z - majestic_z_weight * majestic_z. New-URL score = -position_hat. Survivor score = -((1 - survivor_history_weight) * last_position + survivor_history_weight * mean of earlier positions). With survivor_history_weight 0 this is -last_position.

in_sample.label: IN-SAMPLE fit diagnostics on 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-09 new URLs. Not a forward test.

not_estimated.bm25f_z_weight: Precommitted at 1. One within-query BM25F standard deviation moves the predicted position by one. Same scale as HISTORY_CONTENT_SCALE, fixed before the Nov 9 labels were scored. Not estimated here, because the fit rows have no page text in git.
not_estimated.content_missing: No HTML is in git, so this column does not vary on the fit rows. Weight stays 0. Missing text adds no push and is not a penalty.
not_estimated.majestic_z_weight: No Majestic Million file is in the repo. Weight stays 0. A file passed at score time is recorded and does not move the rank.
not_estimated.survivor_history_weight: The fit window has one previous snapshot, so a blend of earlier positions is not identified. Survivor score is the negative of the latest position.
not_estimated.tranco_z_weight: No Tranco file is in the repo. Weight stays 0. A file passed at score time is recorded and does not move the rank.
